title: The Tank IV: Surface
transcript:
Two. Warm stone under his feet.
Seven. Raman laughing so hard he swallows water.
One. The temple bell. The dog. The heat.
Eight.

The grate. The hand. The choice he made at eleven and has made every night since.

In the black water a small hand finds his. Not pulling this time. Just holding.

RAMAN:
"Again?"

Above him, the surface. In his hand, the fingers.
He can't hold on and swim.
